column4: A conclusion or result reached through research or investigation.

column3: 유의미한, 중요한 — 통계적으로 의미가 있거나 실질적으로 중요한.

column3: 평가 — 학습자의 지식·능력·성과 등을 측정하고 판단하는 일.
column4: The process of judging or measuring someone's knowledge, ability, or performance.

column4: The process of growing or advancing.

column3: 점수 — 시험이나 평가에서 얻은 수치화된 결과.
column4: A number representing performance on a test or measure.

column3: 돕다 — 다른 사람이 어떤 일을 더 쉽게 할 수 있도록 지원하다.
column4: To make it easier for someone to do something; to assist.

column4: To impart knowledge or skill to someone.
Inside the range, limits, or scope of.

column4: Involving careful analytical judgment; also, of decisive importance.

column3: 탐구하다, 탐색하다 — 어떤 대상이나 문제를 자세히 조사하고 살펴보다.
column4: To investigate or examine something in detail.
Throughout or spanning a range of places, groups, or conditions.
To carry out or perform (research, an experiment, etc.).

column4: The act or profession of instructing learners.
To take part or become actively involved in an activity.

column3: 미래의, 향후의 — 앞으로 다가올 시기의.
column4: Of or relating to time yet to come.

column3: 인간의 — 사람에 관한 또는 사람이 지닌.
column4: Of, relating to, or characteristic of people.

column3: ~ 중에, ~ 사이에 — 여럿으로 이루어진 집단의 일부로 또는 그 사이에서.
column4: In the group of; between or within several things or people.

column3: 항목, 문항 — 목록·설문·검사 등을 구성하는 개별 요소.
column4: An individual element in a list, questionnaire, or test.

column3: 개인의, 개별적인 — 한 사람 또는 하나의 대상에 각각 해당하는.
column4: Relating to a single person or thing; separate.

column3: 사고, 생각 — 판단하고 추론하는 정신 활동.
column4: The process of using one's mind to reason or consider.

column3: 만들다, 창출하다 — 새로운 것을 생겨나게 하다.
column4: To bring something new into existence.

column3: 논문, (학술) 글 — 학술지나 잡지 등에 실린 한 편의 글.
column4: A piece of writing published in a journal, magazine, or newspaper.

column3: 쓰다, 작성하다 — 글자나 글로 내용을 적다.
column4: To put words down on paper or screen; to compose text.

column3: 교수(敎授)의, 교육용의 — 가르치는 일이나 수업과 관련된.
column4: Relating to or intended for teaching.

column3: 통합하다 — 여러 요소를 결합하여 하나로 만들다.
column4: To combine parts into a unified whole.

column3: 저자 — 논문이나 책 등을 쓴 사람.
column4: The writer of a paper, book, or other work.

column3: 긍정적인 — 좋거나 바람직한 방향의; 찬성하는.
column4: Favourable, good, or constructive; showing improvement or agreement.

column4: Content or resources used for learning or research.

column3: 통제, 제어 — 어떤 것을 조절하거나 관리하는 것; (실험의) 통제 조건.
column4: The power to manage something; in research, a condition used for comparison.
To draw special attention to; to emphasize.

column3: 보장하다, 확실히 하다 — 어떤 일이 반드시 일어나거나 이루어지도록 하다.
column4: To make certain that something happens or is the case.

column3: 동영상, 비디오 — 움직이는 영상을 기록하거나 재생하는 매체.
column4: A recording of moving images, often with sound.

column3: 평가하다 — 어떤 것의 수준·가치·특성을 판단하다.
column4: To evaluate or judge the quality, level, or value of.

column3: ~와 같은, ~처럼 — 예를 들거나 비슷함을 나타낼 때 쓰는 말.
column4: Such as; similar to.

column4: A word or expression with a specific meaning; also, a period of time.

column3: 여기다, 간주하다; (regarding) ~에 관하여 — 어떤 것을 특정한 관점으로 보다.
column4: To consider in a particular way; (regarding) concerning.

column4: In a statistically significant way; to a considerable extent.

column4: Competence or knowledge in a specified area; originally, the ability to read and write.

column3: 협력적인, 협동의 — 여럿이 함께 목표를 위해 협력하는.
column4: Involving people working together toward a shared goal.

column3: 평가 — 어떤 것의 가치·효과·질을 판단하는 일.
column4: The process of judging the value, quality, or effectiveness of something.

column3: 윤리적인 — 도덕적 원칙에 관련되거나 부합하는.
column4: Relating to or consistent with moral principles.

column3: 개입, 중재 — 결과를 개선하기 위해 의도적으로 실시하는 프로그램이나 조치.
column4: A deliberate program or action intended to improve an outcome.
To make known something previously hidden or unknown.
Existing or simulated by computer technology rather than physically.

column3: 촉진하다, 용이하게 하다 — 어떤 과정이나 행동을 더 쉽게 만들다.
column4: To make an action or process easier.

column3: 주제 — 논의하거나 연구하는 대상이 되는 내용.
column4: A subject of discussion, study, or writing.
A particular area of study or activity.
Of central importance; crucial.

column4: A deep understanding of something, or information that provides it.

column3: 실험의, 실험적인 — 실험에 기반하거나 실험과 관련된.
column4: Relating to or based on experiments.

column3: 인식하다, 지각하다 — 감각이나 생각을 통해 알아차리거나 받아들이다.
column4: To become aware of or regard something in a particular way.

column3: 효과성 — 의도한 결과를 얼마나 잘 달성하는지의 정도.

column4: To show or express something; to think carefully about (reflect on).

column3: 접근, 이용 — 무언가를 사용하거나 얻을 수 있는 기회나 권리.

column3: 자주, 흔히 — 여러 번 반복하여; 대개.
column4: Many times; frequently.
Curiosity or attention toward something.

column4: The body of published research and writing on a particular subject.

column3: 전문적인, 직업의 — 특정 직업이나 전문 분야와 관련된.
column4: Relating to a profession or occupation.

column3: 교수법의, 교육학적인 — 가르치는 방법이나 교육학과 관련된.
column4: Relating to teaching methods or pedagogy.

column3: 행동 — 사람이나 대상이 보이는 행위 방식.
column4: The way a person or thing acts or responds.

column3: 특히 — 다른 것보다 두드러지게.
column4: Especially; to a greater degree than usual.

column4: To be given or get something.

column4: Not having or using; in the absence of.

column3: 창의적인 — 새롭고 독창적인 생각을 만들어 내는.
column4: Having or showing the ability to produce original ideas.

column4: The activity or skill of composing text.

column3: 여전히 ~이다, 남아 있다 — 같은 상태로 계속 있다.

column4: To give special importance to something.

column4: To put a question to someone; to request.

column4: Concerned with actual use or practice rather than theory.

column4: A system of rules; computer program instructions; a label assigned in qualitative analysis.

column4: To give support or confidence; to promote an action.

column4: To obtain or acquire something.

column4: Constantly changing or active.

column4: Relating to or based on theory.

column4: A field of study; a topic; a person studied in research.

column3: 주제, 테마 — (질적 분석에서) 자료에서 반복적으로 드러나는 핵심 의미.
column4: A recurring idea or pattern, especially in qualitative analysis.

column4: Having great force, effect, or degree.

column3: 필수적인 — 반드시 필요한; 본질적인.

column4: Able to be used or obtained.

column3: 초기의, 처음의 — 어떤 과정의 시작 단계에 있는.
column4: Occurring at the beginning; first.

column4: One more; a different one.

column3: 초기의, 이른 — 시간이나 과정의 앞부분에 있는.
column4: Near the beginning of a period or process.

column4: A period of time devoted to a particular activity.

Relating to a particular technology or specialized field.
To find an answer to a problem.
